name: qa-skills
description: Personal agent skills for QA: write test cases from a spec and a design prototype or a screenshot, audit a set that already exists, batch-convert a sprint's workbooks into a repo's own domain YAML, explore a UI for bugs, check a design handoff, turn reviewed cases into Playwright E2E specs with watchable evidence, run a suite and report its results into an Excel workbook plus an offline video viewer, and run a bulk test-case job across fan-out subagents.
